verdict.rationale: The Message Batches API is a first-party feature for processing large volumes of Messages requests asynchronously in one submission, at 50% lower cost and higher throughput. That directly delivers bulk operations across many items. missing for 10: documented batch size limits, status tracking and result-retrieval details, and independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk processing at scale.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
